Of the eight Basic Materials companies reporting earnings this week, three beat EPS estimates, four missed expectations, and one reported in line with analyst forecasts. On the revenue front, seven companies topped consensus estimates, while only one fell short. Overall, revenue performance was stronger than earnings, with a clear majority of companies exceeding sales expectations despite more EPS misses than beats.
